title: Restriction of a derived Chow graph-kernel transform
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be separated and of finite presentation, and let $P=\mathbf P^n_A$ for $n\geq0$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-projective-space-twist]. Put $T=X\times_A P$ with projections $p:T\to X$ and $q:T\to P$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $h:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion, put $b=p\circ h$ and $c=q\circ h$, and suppose that opens $U\subseteq X$ and $V\subseteq P$ satisfy $W=b^{-1}(U)=c^{-1}(V)$, that $b|_W:W\to U$ is an isomorphism, and that $c|_W:W\to V$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Suppose $E\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ satisfies $E|_{X\times_A V}\simeq(h_*\mathcal O_Z)[0]|_{X\times_A V}$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Set $j=(c|_W)\circ(b|_W)^{-1}:U\hookrightarrow V$. For every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ there is an isomorphism in $D(\mathcal O_V)$
$$\left(Rq_*(Lp^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_T}E)\right)|_V\simeq Rj_*(K|_U),$$
where derived pullback and tensor are [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure].

source.place: Tag 0CSK, lemma-compute-Fourier-Mukai-for-derived-chow, displayed derived isomorphism and its proof

proof.text: Put $T_V=X\times_A V=q^{-1}(V)$, with inclusion $a:T_V\hookrightarrow T$, and write $q_V:T_V\to V$, $p_V=p\circ a$. Since $h^{-1}(T_V)=c^{-1}(V)=W$, its base change is $i:W\hookrightarrow T_V$. This is a closed immersion by [lem-pc-closed-imm-base-change]. Put $e=b|_W:W\xrightarrow{\sim}U$ and $u:U\hookrightarrow X$; then $p_Vi=ue$ and $q_Vi=je$ as scheme morphisms, by their components and the definition of $j$.

The ordinary module pushforwards for $h$ and $i$ preserve homology of short complexes by [lem-pc-closed-module-pushforward-homology]. Thus they carry quasi-isomorphisms to quasi-isomorphisms: homology in each degree is the homology of the three-term complex in that degree. Applying them to a K-injective resolution therefore gives $Rh_*(\mathcal O_Z[0])\simeq(h_*\mathcal O_Z)[0]$ and $Ri_*(\mathcal O_W[0])\simeq(i_*\mathcal O_W)[0]$, using the resolution definition of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Apply [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open] to $h$ and the open $T_V$. Since $\mathcal O_Z|_W=\mathcal O_W$, the assumed kernel isomorphism becomes $E|_{T_V}\simeq Ri_*(\mathcal O_W[0])$.

Apply [lem-pc-restrict-derived-direct-image-open] to $q$ and $V$, and apply [lem-pc-derived-tensor-open-restriction-natural] to the integrand. Restriction is derived pullback along an open immersion: its structural ring map is an isomorphism, so the tensor expression defining [def-pc-derived-pullback] reduces to exact restriction. The composition comparison [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] identifies $(Lp^*K)|_{T_V}$ with $Lp_V^*K$. With $M=Lp_V^*K$ the left side of the desired formula is consequently $Rq_{V*}(M\otimes^L Ri_*(\mathcal O_W[0]))$.

Check the projection-formula hypotheses. The affine-local conclusion of [lem-pc-derived-pullback-qcoh-component] for $p_V,K$ covers $T_V$, so $M\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{T_V})$ by the local definition [pqf-def-coherent]. Also $\mathcal O_W[0]\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_W)$: on $\operatorname{Spec}B$ its only nonzero cohomology is $\widetilde B$. The affine description in [def-weil-closed-immersion] gives $i^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}R)=\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)$, hence $i$ is quasi-compact. A closed immersion is a monomorphism: its topological embedding determines the map on points, and its surjective structure-sheaf map determines the map on sheaves. Thus its diagonal is an isomorphism and in particular quasi-compact, so $i$ is quasi-separated by [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. These checks need neither quasi-compactness of $V$ nor finite presentation of $i$.

Apply [lem-pc-projection-formula] to $i$, $\mathcal O_W[0]$ and $M$. The tensor symmetry $F\otimes^LG\cong G\otimes^LF$ of [lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction] and the unit $\mathcal O_W[0]$ of [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] give $M\otimes^L Ri_*(\mathcal O_W[0])\simeq Ri_*(Li^*M)$. Apply $Rq_{V*}$. By [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition] and [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] the result is $R(q_Vi)_*L(p_Vi)^*K\simeq R(je)_*Le^*(K|_U)$; here the open pullback $Lu^*K=K|_U$ is the restriction computation already given in step 3.

Derived pullback along $e$ is an equivalence: pullback along its inverse is an inverse by the unital composition isomorphisms of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Its right adjoint $Re_*$ from [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] is therefore an inverse, and $Re_*Le^*(K|_U)\simeq K|_U$. Finally [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition] gives $R(je)_*Le^*(K|_U)\simeq Rj_*Re_*Le^*(K|_U)\simeq Rj_*(K|_U)$. Composing the preceding derived isomorphisms proves the assertion in $D(\mathcal O_V)$.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q28-350cd6c08 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read Stacks more-morphisms.tex lemma-derived-chow and 0CSK (statement and proof), plus 08FE, 08EU and 08DW(1); tags 0D5S, 0D5T, 08KS and 01JY checked. The item statement is unchanged and is a faithful generalization of 0CSK: it drops only f.p. of Z, pseudo-coherence of E and the f.p. conclusion on j, none of which the computation uses. The output is in D(O_V), K is in D_QCoh(O_X), and the citer 0CSL gets what it needs. Steps 1-6 check out against the cited statements: closed base change gives i; exact closed pushforward plus the K-injective definition gives Ri_*O_W=i_*O_W; 08FE restriction for h and q; tensor restriction; open pullback is restriction; the D_QCoh/qcqs hypotheses are checked without quasi-compactness of V; the 08EU projection formula; composition; Le* is an equivalence so Re_*Le*≅id. Edge cases checked: empty U/V, K=0, graph case, non-quasi-compact V, unbounded K. No new nodes and no duplicates (rg -L for 0CSK, derived-chow, 08EU). The nine tool_uses are generic picard derived tools and are accepted. FIX (C4): step 5 used tensor symmetry attributed to def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure, which states no symmetry. I now cite lem-sc-derived-internal-hom-adjunction ('Moreover' K⊗^L L≅L⊗^L K) in the step's uses, proof_deps and tool_uses. lean.statement: theorem derivedChow_transform_restriction (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (n : ℕ) [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (X P T Z : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (eP : P ≅ Proj.projectiveSpaceOverAffine (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) A) (p : T ⟶ X) (q : T ⟶ P) (_hT : IsPullback p q f (eP.hom ≫ Proj.projectiveSpaceOverAffineToSpec (ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1))) A)) (h : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion h] (U : X.Opens) (V : P.Opens) (W : Z.Opens) (hWU : W = (h ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hWV : W = (h ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ V) [IsIso ((h ≫ p).resLE U W hWU.le)] [IsClosedImmersion ((h ≫ q).resLE V W hWV.le)] (E : schemeDerivedCategory T) (_hE : Nonempty ((schemeOpenRestriction T (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅ (schemeOpenRestriction T (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward h).obj (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)))))) (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) : Nonempty ((schemeOpenRestriction P V).mapDerivedCategory.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage q).obj ((derivedPullback p).obj K.obj ⊗ E)) ≅ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (inv ((h ≫ p).resLE U W hWU.le) ≫ (h ≫ q).resLE V W hWV.le)).obj ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj))
lean.note: P is identified with the affine Proj construction by eP, and T with the fibre product by IsPullback. The graph map is explicitly inv(b|W) followed by c|W; open restrictions use the existing schemeOpenRestriction and its induced derived functor.
